name: Jason Marsden
bio: Jason Christopher Marsden (born January 3, 1975) is an American screen and voice actor. His voice roles include Max Goof (since A Goofy Movie in 1995), Haku in the English dub of Spirited Away (2002), Chester McBadbat in The Fairly OddParents (2003 - 2011), and Thackery Binx in Hocus Pocus (1993).
